item.title: Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX) IPO Process: A Practical Research Report
item.description: Listing eligibility, review procedures, key deadlines and practical considerations for the Main Board and GEM. Information current as of 26 November 2026. The rule basis is the Main Board Listing Rules and GEM Listing Rules currently in force, together with public documents of HKEX and the SFC. 1. Executive Summary This report sets out the complete initial public offering (IPO) process on the Main Board and GEM of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX), focusing on three questions: who can list, who does the work, and in what sequence and over what timeframe.

item.title: The Way of Heaven and the Way of Man: The Ancient Wisdom Behind the Wealth Gap
item.description: Note: This is my original note and commentary based on episode 7 of the AI Historical Anecdotes series by the Douyin account “Who Moved My History”. It is not a verbatim transcript. The original video was published on 2026-09-03, and the creator states the content is AI-generated. Original video: v.douyin.com/6XIgWJ9wKLM The video is framed as a dialogue with Laozi and uses the Daodejing’s line “The Way of Heaven reduces the surplus to supplement the deficient; the Way of Man does the opposite, taking from the deficient to serve the surplus” as its thesis.

item.title: AWS DynamoDB Basic Usage
item.description: DynamoDB Basic Concepts Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service that provides fast, predictable performance and seamless scalability. Basic structure DynamoDB has a few core concepts: tables, items, and attributes. A table is a collection of items, and each item is a collection of attributes. You can think of them as the equivalent of collections, documents, and fields in MongoDB. Primary keys in DynamoDB Unlike MongoDB, DynamoDB does not generate an _id by default to uniquely identify a record.
